headword: {日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}
gloss: everyday occurrence; commonplace event; routine matter

definitions.explanation: Something that happens so frequently that it is considered ordinary and unremarkable.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{遅延|ちえん}はこの{路線|ろせん}では{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}だ。
examples.english: Train delays are an everyday occurrence on this line.

examples.japanese: {残業|ざんぎょう}は{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}になっている。
examples.english: Overtime has become a daily routine.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}にとって{徹夜|てつや}は{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently pulling all-nighters is routine for him.

notes:
WORD FORMATION (YOJIJUKUGO):
{日常|にちじょう} (daily life) + {茶飯事|さはんじ} (tea and rice = everyday meals)
→ as ordinary as daily tea and rice = everyday occurrence

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜は{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}だ - ~ is an everyday occurrence
・{日常茶飯事|にちじょうさはんじ}になる - to become routine

NUANCE:
Often used with slightly negative or resigned tone, suggesting something happens too frequently. Can imply that something that should be unusual has become normalized.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・よくあること - something that happens often
・{当|あ}たり{前|まえ} - natural, obvious
